elements.label: Figure B1
elements.title: R Help Menu Based on help.start()
elements.details: Screenshot of the R Help Menu interface showing sections: Manuals, Reference, and Miscellaneous Material. Under Manuals: 'An Introduction to R', 'Writing R Extensions', 'R Data Import/Export', 'The R Language Definition', 'R Installation and Administration', 'R Internals'. Under Reference: 'Packages', 'Search Engine & Keywords'. Under Miscellaneous Material: 'About R', 'License', 'NEWS', 'Authors', 'Frequently Asked Questions', 'User Manuals', 'Resources', 'Thanks', 'Technical papers'. The top shows 'Statistical Data Analysis' with the R logo.
elements.summary: This figure shows the R Help Menu interface that appears when typing help.start() at the R prompt, providing access to manuals, references, and miscellaneous materials for R users.
